prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Droven Bearmantle. Character visual motifs: rugged warden in patched antlered mantle accompanied by a massive **moss-backed pack tortoise**, not a spirit bear or shapeshifter.
TOP LEFT: Shared Heartbeat. Ability concept: Droven and the tortoise Hark have a shared reserve of 220 guard energy; damage absorbed by Hark drains guard. Hark does not respawn instantly after destruction.
TOP RIGHT: Hark, Settle. Ability concept: directs Hark to a nearby point where he plants as a 55-GU-wide **walk-around obstacle** for 4 s. Hark can be attacked; allies may pass through slowly.
BOTTOM LEFT: Shelter Under Shell. Ability concept: Hark opens his shell to cover one nearby ally with 20% incoming-damage redirection to guard energy for 2.5 s. Droven temporarily loses part of his own armor while energy is transferred.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Carry the Line. Ability concept: Hark slowly advances 100 GU over 4 s as moving cover. Allies behind his shell gain limited projectile protection; opponents can flank Hark or destroy the shell's guard energy.
